title: Coconut Catch Tip
text: Coconut Catch rewards steady horizontal basket movement. Avoid hazards first; combo only matters after safe positioning.

title: Turtle Flip Tip
text: In Turtle Flip, remember card positions by quadrant. In two-player mode, successful matches can shift momentum quickly.

title: Sand Sort Tip
text: Use the clear bottle as a temporary buffer. Do not fill it too early; save it for separating a blocked top color.
